sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant made all his best efforts but could not arrange the money to deposit hence, he could not released on bail.
He is in jail since 8.12.2021 i.e. for more than 1  years and there is no minimum sentence provided u/s. 420, 417 and 34 of the IPC.
The condition was imposed for his immediate release, but he could not be released.
Therefore, looking to the period of custody now, such condition can be relaxed.
There is also delay in the trial as the complainant is not appearing before the trial Court.
All other accused have been enlarged on bail.
The applicant never projected himself as a manufacturer.
The company is engaged in the sale of cement and TMT bars.

The agreement is still valid for a period of 11 years, therefore, the security amount which is deposited is still valid for a period of 11 years, hence there cannot be forfeiture of the security amount deposited by the respondent No.2.
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the respondents oppose the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this application.

Looking to the period of custody and as no minimum sentence is provided u/s. 420,
417 of the IPC, the condition of depositing Rs.40,00,000/- can be relaxed.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. is allowed.
The condition of depositing Rs.40,00,000/- in order dated 11.5.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.20260/2022 is hereby relaxed.
C.C. as per rules.

( VIVEK RUSIA ) JUDGE Alok/-
